name: KPK USDC Yield V2
oneLiner: KPK USDC Yield V2 is a KPK-curated Morpho V2 USDC lending vault; shares accrue interest, absorb losses, and redeem subject to liquidity.
collateral: USDC-denominated idle balances and lender positions in KPK-curated Morpho markets. Borrower collateral, valuation and market liquidity vary; the share does not represent cash held solely at the parent issuer.
pegMechanism: ERC-4626 deposits exchange USDC for NAV-bearing shares. Borrower interest and configured fee-share accrual change assets per share; realized lending losses can reduce NAV. Withdraw/redeem burns shares for idle USDC and liquidity from the configured adapter; force-deallocation is separate and cannot create liquidity in fully borrowed markets. VaultV2 deliberately returns zero from maxWithdraw and maxRedeem as conservative underestimates, not measurements of available exit liquidity.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Exact Ethereum 0xd5cce260e7a755ddf0fb9cdf06443d593aaeaa13 issues a proportional operational position in Morpho lending strategies over USDC. VaultV2 exit code burns shares against available assets and recognizes losses; holder exposure differs from the fiat-cash parent. At Ethereum block 26107704, asset()=0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48, totalSupply()=9792630120840452584390720 raw 18-decimal shares and totalAssets()=10295065635649 raw 6-decimal USDC. One adapter 0x4f74895557bea2de5d51d8c06e944da92dbc8550 enumerates 5 current market IDs; summed expectedSupplyAssets=9983200606668, idle underlying=311865028981; their sum equals totalAssets. All current positions have zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. This is an operational proportional lending-position claim. It is not direct ownership of the parent issuer reserve, an independently signed financial reconciliation, or proof of legal segregation and insolvency priority.
